# color

Color conversions

## Index

| Operation               | Description
|-------------------------|------------
| [`cmyk-rgb`](#cmyk-rgb) | CMYK to RGB
| [`hsl-rgb`](#hsl-rgb)   | HSL to RGB 
| [`rgb-cmyk`](#rgb-cmyk) | RGB to CMYK
| [`rgb-hsl`](#rgb-hsl)   | RGB to HSL 


## Operations

### cmyk-rgb

Converts a color from the CMYK to RGB color space.

Stack effects:
```
( c:Int/u8 m:Int/u8 y:Int/u8 k:Int/u8 -- r:Int/u8 g:Int/u8 b:Int/u8 )
```

Example:

| Input                    | Stack            
|--------------------------|------------------
| `0 127 191 127 cmyk-rgb` | `128 \| 64 \| 32`

### hsl-rgb

Converts a color from the HSL to RGB color space.

Stack effects:
```
( h:Float/64 s:Float/64 l:Float/64 -- r:Int/u8 g:Int/u8 b:Int/u8 )
```

Example:

| Input                  | Stack            
|------------------------|------------------
| `20 0.6 0.314 hsl-rgb` | `128 \| 64 \| 32`

### rgb-cmyk

Converts a color from the RGB to CMYK color space.

Stack effects:
```
( r:Int/u8 g:Int/u8 b:Int/u8 -- c:Int/u8 m:Int/u8 y:Int/u8 k:Int/u8 )
```

Example:

| Input                | Stack                   
|----------------------|-------------------------
| `128 64 32 rgb-cmyk` | `0 \| 127 \| 191 \| 127`

### rgb-hsl

Converts a color from the RGB to HSL color space.

Stack effects:
```
( r:Int/u8 g:Int/u8 b:Int/u8 -- h:Float/64 s:Float/64 l:Float/64 )
```

Example:

| Input                             | Stack               
|-----------------------------------|---------------------
| `128 64 32 rgb-hsl [3 round] map` | `20 \| 0.6 \| 0.314`
